name: ugt-gemini-media
description: Optional, any stack: Gemini MCP servers for text-to-speech (gemini-tts: speak → .wav, Thai + English) and image generation/processing (gemini-image). Asks for one personal Gemini API key when the plugin is enabled; the key is kept with Claude Code's own login secrets, not in env vars. Every call is billed to that key.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: https://aistudio.google.com/apikey — your own key; usage is billed to it
